extension.summary: Server-side search and Douban rating bridge for the Mistuary skin
Mistuary 皮肤的服务端搜索与豆瓣评分桥
extension.description: Optional add-on. Search uses the Emby server, so Chinese titles, original titles, full pinyin and initials work like in the Emby app. Douban ratings are read from the StrmAssistant Emby plugin first (falling back to the public Douban API), and can optionally be written into the Kodi library as a separate "douban" rating so skins can tell Douban apart from TMDB/IMDb. The main rating is never changed.
可选插件。搜索走 Emby 服务端，支持中文标题、原名、全拼和首字母；详情页豆瓣评分优先从 StrmAssistant 插件读取（失败再回退豆瓣公开接口）。可选把豆瓣评分写入 Kodi 媒体库，作为独立的「豆瓣」评分，让皮肤能区分豆瓣与 TMDB/IMDb；不会改动主评分。
extension.disclaimer: 只在本地读取 Emby 插件的服务器配置，令牌不会写入日志或缓存。
